.quora-inner{
  --qi-black: #050505;
  --qi-ink: #111;
  --qi-muted: #686868;
  --qi-line: #dfdfdf;
  --qi-paper: #f7f7f5;
  --qi-orange: #ff5a2f;
  --qi-radius: 28px;
  --qi-shared-gesture-spring: linear(0, 0.1873, 0.4978, 0.7484, 0.9025, 0.9795, 1.0091, 1.0152, 1.0123, 1.0076, 1.0038, 1.0015, 1);
  color: var(--qi-ink);
  background: #fff;
  font-family: "Urbanist", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow: clip;
}

.quora-inner *,
.quora-inner *::before,
.quora-inner *::after{ box-sizing: border-box; }
.quora-inner img{ display: block; width: 100%; }
.quora-inner a{ color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.quora-inner button,
.quora-inner input,
.quora-inner select,
.quora-inner textarea{ font: inherit; }
.quora-inner h1,
.quora-inner h2,
.quora-inner h3,
.quora-inner h4,
.quora-inner p,
.quora-inner figure,
.quora-inner blockquote{ margin: 0; }
.qi-inner-section{ padding: clamp(72px, 9vw, 140px) clamp(24px, 4.5vw, 70px); }
.qi-kicker{
  color: var(--qi-orange);
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.qi-display{
  font-size: clamp(54px, 7.6vw, 118px);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -.065em;
  line-height: .88;
}

.qi-section-head{
  display: grid;
  gap: 28px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(280px, .65fr);
  margin-bottom: clamp(46px, 7vw, 100px);
}

.qi-section-head h2{
  font-size: clamp(42px, 5.4vw, 82px);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -.055em;
  line-height: .95;
}

.qi-section-head p{
  color: var(--qi-muted);
  font-size: clamp(18px, 1.8vw, 25px);
  justify-self: end;
  max-width: 540px;
}

.qi-button{
  align-items: center;
  background: #080808;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #fff !important;
  display: inline-flex;
  font-size: 14px;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 14px 18px 14px 22px;
  width: max-content;
}

.qi-button span{
  align-items: center;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #111;
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 27px;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 27px;
}

.qi-button::before{
  display: none;
  content: none;
}

.qi-reveal{
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(30px);
  transition: opacity .72s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform .72s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}
.qi-reveal.is-visible{ opacity: 1; transform: none; }

.qi-image-hero{
  color: #fff;
  height: min(900px, 100vh);
  min-height: 650px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.qi-image-hero::after{
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.08), rgba(0,0,0,.02) 40%, rgba(0,0,0,.55));
  content: "";
  inset: 0;
  position: absolute;
}

.qi-image-hero > img{
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.qi-image-hero-content{
  bottom: clamp(45px, 8vw, 118px);
  max-width: 650px;
  position: absolute;
  right: clamp(28px, 6vw, 92px);
  text-align: right;
  z-index: 2;
}

.qi-image-hero-content h1{
  font-size: clamp(48px, 5.7vw, 86px);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -.055em;
  line-height: .92;
}

.qi-image-hero-content p{
  font-size: clamp(17px, 1.6vw, 23px);
  margin: 26px 0 28px auto;
  max-width: 560px;
}

.qi-image-hero-content .qi-button{ margin-left: auto; }

.qi-page-hero{
  padding: 130px clamp(24px, 4.5vw, 70px) 64px;
}
.qi-page-hero-inner{
  margin-left: auto;
  max-width: 820px;
  text-align: right;
}
.qi-page-hero .qi-icon-badge{
  align-items: center;
  background: #f3f3f3;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-flex;
  font-size: 22px;
  height: 52px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
  width: 52px;
}
.qi-page-hero h1{

  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -.065em;
  line-height: .92;
}
.qi-page-hero p{
  font-size: clamp(18px, 1.7vw, 24px);

  max-width: 650px;

.qi-form-status{ color: #456b38; font-size: 13px; }

.quora-inner :where(a, button, input, select, textarea):focus-visible{

}

.qi-reveal{
  --qi-from-x: 0px;
  --qi-from-y: 30px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(var(--qi-from-x), var(--qi-from-y), 0);
  transition:
    opacity 720ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) var(--qi-delay, 0ms),
    transform 720ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) var(--qi-delay, 0ms);
}

.qi-reveal--left{

}

}

.qi-reveal.is-visible{

}
